mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% over three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which boosts related industries and increases economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% over two months signals a weakening supply side, which may indicate a slowdown in economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which reduces uncertainty and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between rising real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) over three months signals a strong consumer-driven economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 2% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases by more than 2% and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a single month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over two quarters signals a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 increases by more than 2% over two quarters.
